proposed.P-1: Step cadence: the next queued step's first advance is one cadence slot after the previous advance; an idle sprite starts on the tick the command arrives.
proposed.P-2: Grid path nodes are the tile's bottom-centre reference point (32 cx + 16, 32 cy + 31); edges are checked by sweeping the base in 4 px samples.
proposed.P-3: A pixel-mode direction step moves 4 px on each axis in one advance; other advances use a Euclidean 4 px increment truncated to 1/256 px.
proposed.P-4: A step ends when its target is reached or passed (non-positive projection on the original direction); a blocked step ends alone and the next queued step continues.
proposed.P-5: R-54 slide: select the hit edge by canonically ordered endpoints independently of vertex order; the turned step has the same length, and the facing is the octant of its vector.
proposed.P-6: Triggers are evaluated when a player step completes and when the activation key is pressed; a repeat region fires on entry then every distanceRepeat px; losing candidates are not marked fired; re-arming is evaluated at step completion.
proposed.P-7: Item activation turns the item to face the player and clears the player's queue (E-43).
proposed.P-8: Trigger programs are modelled as ops (set, gone, abort, silentMove); silent movement locks trigger evaluation until the player's queue drains and evaluates nothing at the end.
proposed.P-9: An item hidden by its loading condition starts no thread; showing it later starts the thread and hiding or removing it stops the thread.
proposed.P-10: Random encounter: type 0 draws one integer in [0, chances) per tile moved and fights on 0; type 1 counts tiles; a fight draws a count 1 + [0, 4) then one index into the skill-level pool per enemy.
proposed.P-11: Edge arrival keeps the player's remaining queue on refusal and clears it on success; send() names a position in the destination board's own coordinate mode - one-based tiles at the tile's bottom-centre on a plain board, board pixels on a board that sets the pixel-coordinate flag; the layer is one-based.
proposed.P-12: With diagonals disabled, two held orthogonal directions move along the most recently pressed one.
proposed.P-13: Button slot hit-test is half-open [x, x + w) x [y, y + h); an enabled slot press is one key-queue entry for its action; a disabled slot swallows the click.
proposed.P-14: Animation: frame delays are round-half-up ticks (minimum 1); a state change resets the frame; idle starts after idleMs of no movement; a held stance releases when movement resumes.
proposed.P-15: Movement and key waits are polled in the `waits` phase, so a thread resumes on the tick after the movement completes; movement started from a blocking thread implies the wait.
proposed.P-16: Diversion and the pathfinder treat every other visible sprite on the layer as an obstacle; a route counts only if it reaches the goal; the 120-tick wait retests each tick.
proposed.P-17: Pathfinder conventions: step costs 10 (4-way) and 10 / 14 (8-way), Manhattan and octile heuristics, ties by (f, x, y, insertion); nearest free node by squared distance then (x, y); the capped search approaches the expanded node nearest the goal; vector mode handles axis-aligned solids and keeps the whole base on the board.
proposed.P-18: Gamepad edges are computed on the merged held state: an action already held by another source appends no queue entry.
